Search latency regression in 5.3.0
- The p95 of /v2/search climbed from 212 ms to 640 ms after the 5.3.0 release.
- The median stayed at 48 ms, so only the tail is affected.
- The profile points at normalize_query().

p95 of /v2/search tripled after 5.3.0
Tail latency on the search endpoint is now 640 ms, up from 212 ms. Typical requests are unchanged. A flame graph attributes the extra time to normalize_query, which is where to start.

Title: /v2/search p95 regression after 5.3.0

GET /v2/search p95 rose from 212 ms to 640 ms after release 5.3.0 on example-store. The median is unchanged. The flame graph points at normalize_query(). The pod cold start is a separate known issue and is out of scope here.
